Package org.uma.evolver.smac

Class ConfigSpaceGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.smac.ConfigSpaceGenerator
public final class ConfigSpaceGenerator extends Object
Writes a parameter space of Evolver as a configuration space of ConfigSpace, the format that SMAC3 reads (ConfigurationSpace.from_json), as IraceParameterDescriptionGenerator does for irace.

Every parameter of the space becomes a hyperparameter: a categorical one (the values of a categorical parameter, the integers of a categorical integer one, "true" and "false" for a boolean one), a uniform_int or a uniform_float one with the range of the parameter. The relations between parameters become conditions: a conditional parameter is active when its parent takes the value that declares it (EQ, or IN when it is declared by several values), and a global sub-parameter whenever its parent is active (IN with all the values of the parent). A hyperparameter whose parent is not active is not active either, so the conditions of a parameter do not need to repeat those of its ancestors.

The default value of each hyperparameter is, when a default configuration is given, its value in that configuration, so that SMAC3 can start from the default configuration of the algorithm. Otherwise (and for the parameters that the default configuration does not activate) it is the first value of a categorical parameter and the middle of the range of a numeric one. 


 java -cp Evolver-*-jar-with-dependencies.jar org.uma.evolver.smac.ConfigSpaceGenerator \
     NSGAIIDouble.yaml Double defaultConfigurations/NSGAIIDoubleDefault.txt > NSGAIIDouble.json
